product_overview: HirebridgeHR Backend is a multi-tenant Applicant Tracking System (ATS) REST API for enterprise recruiting workflows. It supports secure authentication, job management, candidate tracking, interviews, analytics, notifications, and super-admin platform oversight.
core_goals: Provide secure multi-tenant ATS operations with organization-based isolation
Support role-based access control across enterprise recruiter and candidate workflows
Enable end-to-end job posting, application, interview, and hiring pipeline management
Offer self-service candidate registration and profile access
Deliver analytics, notifications, and platform administration capabilities for operational visibility

features.name: Authentication & Session Management
features.description: Allows enterprise users and candidates to register, sign in, refresh sessions, view their profile, and log out securely with JWT access and rotating refresh tokens.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with valid enterprise recruiter details -> Receive 201 with created OWNER account and organization context -> POST /api/auth/login with same credentials -> Receive 200 with access token and refresh token -> GET /api/auth/me with access token -> Receive 200 with authenticated user profile

POST /api/auth/candidate/signup with valid candidate details -> Receive 201 with created CANDIDATE account -> POST /api/auth/login with candidate credentials -> Receive 200 with access token and refresh token -> GET /api/auth/me with access token -> Receive 200 with candidate identity and tenant scope

POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> POST /api/auth/refresh without a valid refresh token -> Receive 401 or token validation error -> POST /api/auth/logout without active session -> Receive 200/204 session cleared response

features.name: Multi-Tenant Job Management
features.description: Supports secure creation, listing, updating, saving, applying to, and deleting job postings across tenant organizations, with public browsing for candidates.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid recruiter credentials -> Receive 200 with access token -> POST /api/v1/jobs with token and valid job payload -> Receive 201 with created job posting -> GET /api/v1/jobs with token or public access -> Receive 200 with filtered job list -> GET /api/v1/jobs/:id -> Receive 200 with full job details

GET /api/v1/jobs without auth -> Receive 200 with active public jobs list -> POST /api/jobs/:jobId/apply with candidate application data -> Receive 201 with submitted application -> POST /api/jobs/:jobId/apply again for the same candidate -> Receive 409 duplicate application prevention error

POST /api/auth/login with recruiter credentials -> Receive 200 with access token -> PUT /api/v1/jobs/:id with updated fields -> Receive 200 with updated job posting -> DELETE /api/v1/jobs/:id -> Receive 200/204 with job archived or deleted

POST /api/jobs/:id/save with expired or missing token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> POST /api/auth/login with candidate credentials -> Receive 200 with access token -> POST /api/jobs/:id/save with token -> Receive 200 with saved job confirmation

features.name: Candidate & Talent Pool Management
features.description: Enables recruiters to create, search, update, and evaluate candidate profiles, while allowing candidates to access their own self-service profile.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with recruiter credentials -> Receive 200 with access token -> POST /api/v1/candidates with valid candidate profile data -> Receive 201 with created candidate record -> GET /api/v1/candidates/:id -> Receive 200 with candidate details -> POST /api/v1/candidates/:id/notes with rating and note -> Receive 201 with note recorded

GET /api/v1/candidates without auth -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> POST /api/auth/login with recruiter credentials -> Receive 200 with access token -> GET /api/v1/candidates with search filters -> Receive 200 with filtered candidate results

POST /api/auth/candidate/signup with candidate details -> Receive 201 with created candidate account -> POST /api/auth/login with candidate credentials -> Receive 200 with access token -> GET /api/candidates/me -> Receive 200 with self-service candidate profile
PUT /api/v1/candidates/:id with invalid candidate payload -> Receive 400 validation error -> GET /api/v1/candidates/:id with insufficient permissions -> Receive 403 forbidden response

features.name: Application Pipeline & Recruitment Workflow
features.description: Tracks applications across hiring stages, supports stage changes, application lookup, and candidate withdrawal with auditability.
user_flows: POST /api/jobs/:jobId/apply with candidate data -> Receive 201 with new application in APPLIED stage -> GET /api/v1/applications/:id with recruiter token -> Receive 200 with application details -> PUT /api/v1/applications/:id with stage update to SCREENING -> Receive 200 with updated hiring stage

POST /api/auth/login with recruiter credentials -> Receive 200 with access token -> GET /api/v1/applications with job and stage filters -> Receive 200 with matching applications -> PUT /api/v1/applications/:id with next stage value -> Receive 200 with persisted stage transition and audit trail

POST /api/auth/login with candidate credentials -> Receive 200 with access token -> PATCH /api/applications/:id/withdraw -> Receive 200 with application marked WITHDRAWN -> GET /api/v1/applications/:id -> Receive 200 with withdrawn status

PUT /api/v1/applications/:id with invalid stage transition or malformed body -> Receive 400 validation or business rule error -> GET /api/v1/applications/:id for missing record -> Receive 404 not found response

features.name: Interview Management
features.description: Schedules interviews, lists upcoming interviews, and records interview updates or feedback for candidate evaluation.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with recruiter credentials -> Receive 200 with access token -> POST /api/v1/interviews with candidate, interviewer, datetime, and type -> Receive 201 with scheduled interview -> GET /api/v1/interviews -> Receive 200 with scheduled interview list -> PUT /api/v1/interviews/:id with feedback -> Receive 200 with saved interview feedback
POST /api/v1/interviews with missing required interview fields -> Receive 400 validation error -> PUT /api/v1/interviews/:id with unauthorized user -> Receive 401 or 403 response

GET /api/v1/interviews without valid auth -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> POST /api/auth/login with hiring manager credentials -> Receive 200 with access token -> GET /api/v1/interviews -> Receive 200 with accessible interview schedule

features.name: Reports & Analytics
features.description: Provides aggregated recruitment metrics and funnel visibility for staffing performance and operational review.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with recruiter or admin credentials -> Receive 200 with access token -> GET /api/v1/reports/overview -> Receive 200 with aggregated ATS analytics overview

GET /api/v1/reports/overview without auth -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> POST /api/auth/login with insufficient-role user -> Receive 200 with access token -> GET /api/v1/reports/overview -> Receive 403 forbidden response

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Surfaces application and interview alerts for authenticated users and supports clearing notification states.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with authenticated user credentials -> Receive 200 with access token -> GET /api/v1/notifications -> Receive 200 with notification list -> PATCH /api/v1/notifications/read-all -> Receive 200 with all notifications marked as read
GET /api/v1/notifications with expired token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> PATCH /api/v1/notifications/read-all without auth -> Receive 401 unauthorized response

features.name: Platform Administration
features.description: Allows super admins to inspect organizations, users, job publication queues, and audit logs across the platform.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with SUPER_ADMIN credentials -> Receive 200 with access token -> GET /api/v1/admin/organizations -> Receive 200 with organization list -> GET /api/v1/admin/users -> Receive 200 with global user list -> GET /api/v1/admin/audit-logs -> Receive 200 with immutable audit trail

POST /api/auth/login with non-admin user credentials -> Receive 200 with access token -> GET /api/v1/admin/organizations -> Receive 403 forbidden response -> GET /api/v1/admin/job-publications -> Receive 403 forbidden response
GET /api/v1/admin/users without auth -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> GET /api/v1/admin/audit-logs with expired token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response
